title: DiseaseDocument
description: Canonical disease record for PashuMitra AI knowledge base ingestion, RAG retrieval, confidence scoring, and triage.

disease_id.description: Stable slug identifier used as the primary key across storage and APIs.

animal_type.description: Primary livestock species for this record.

description.description: Clinical summary used for retrieval and farmer-facing context.

symptoms.description: Observable signs associated with the disease.

critical_symptoms.description: Symptoms that warrant urgent veterinary escalation; must be a subset of symptoms.

first_aid.description: Immediate, farmer-safe care steps before professional treatment.

severity_level.description: Baseline severity of the disease in the knowledge base.
